title: Disks and devices panel opens itself on reboot when Snap apps are installed
line: Snap and fstab loop devices no longer open the Disks & Devices popup by themselves or stay listed as removable devices; loop devices you set up yourself still show up.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.7 the Disks & Devices widget counts a loop device as removable when it is not mounted at the moment it appears, so that people can mount disk images they attached themselves. Snap packages and fstab image entries are loop devices that root sets up and mounts a moment later, so at boot (or on a snap refresh) they briefly look unused: the widget opened its popup by itself and kept them listed with 'Safely remove'. Now an unused loop device only counts as removable if the current user set it up (UDisks2 SetupByUID), so the system's loop devices are ignored.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: don't treat system loop devices as removable

Snap and fstab loop devices are not mounted yet when they appear, so
they counted as removable, opened the popup by themselves and stayed
listed. Only unused loop devices set up by the user count as removable.

BUG: 521908

media.caption: Master: a root-owned squashfs loop device (like a snap) appears unmounted; the Disks & Devices popup opens by itself and offers 'Mount and Open'
With the fix, same device: no popup, no Disks & Devices icon in the tray
Master: after the device is mounted at /snap/test/1 it stays listed as a removable device with 'Safely remove'
With the fix, after the mount, Disks & Devices opened by hand: 'No removable devices attached'
